newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down as C. Bank buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down as C. Bank buys dollars.

text.p: The Philippine peso slipped at the close on Wednesday after the Central Bank bought dollars in late trading, dealers said.
Ito ended at 26.368 to the dollar from 26.365.
"The Central Bank bought dollars in preparation for the lowering of overnight rates," a trader said.
Traders said the Central Bank may cut its overnight borrowing rate by two percentage points to 14 percent on Thursday, which may encourage banks to buy up the dollar again.
The dollars the Central Bank bought, estimated at $58 million at the rates of 26.363 to 26.368 pesos, will be used to cap a possible weakness in the peso, traders said.
Banks continue to remain cautious in case another attack on the Thai baht spills over to the peso, a dealer said.
Turnover was moderate at $178 million on Wednesday but higher than the previous $161.2 million.
